2123258734197579811.en_summary: Everyone on X mentioning 2018 analogues, reminding of 10 black Mondays called this year. Fed backdrop similar, central banks/admin want market to cool for wealth effect after midterms focused on affordability. Not ruling out, especially if Fed goes 50bps then serious. But if only 25bps as priced and growth decent, still thinks second half of December positive. Next week setting up for some upside.
2123258734197579811.zh_summary: X上每個人都在提及2018年類比，讓人想起今年被喊出的10個黑色星期一。聯準會背景相似，央行/行政部門在中期選舉聚焦可負擔性後肯定希望市場降溫以產生財富效應。並未排除，特別是如果聯準會瘋狂到降50基點就知道他們認真了。但如果只降25基點如定價且增長背景仍不錯，仍認為12月下半月正面。下週也設定得相當不錯有些上漲空間。

2123257203939594322.en_summary: Sat down with @MarediaShehzan to understand why bitcoin isn’t going up, who has been selling, and why he thinks most sellers are now gone. Discuss bitcoin security, the halving, bitcoin vs gold, how people outside US are earning bitcoin with stablecoins, and why gambling platforms are pushing users toward bitcoin-only banking.
2123257203939594322.zh_summary: 與 @MarediaShehzan 坐下了解為什麼比特幣沒有上漲、誰一直在賣出，以及為什麼他認為大多數賣家現在已經消失。討論比特幣安全性、減半、比特幣對黃金、美國以外的人如何用穩定幣賺取比特幣，以及為什麼賭博平台推動用戶轉向僅比特幣銀行。

2123254736388243631.en_summary: Wall Street giants pledged to mobilize $500 billion to help Nvidia customers finance chip purchases. But no capital has been deployed to date. Jensen Huang sensed the winds shifting against Nvidia this spring. In August he got pledges from Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize $500 billion. To date no capital actually deployed.
